about:
More: lara.dev. Startup Founder, Agency Leader & Fractional CTO for enterprise brands on Shopify. I've honed my skills in engineering, design, and business in the fast-paced worlds of agencies and startups, leading full rebuilds and complex integration projects for: Marine Layer, OUAI, Victoria's Secret, Crocs, Allbirds, Suja, Levi's, Vive, MOEN, the Outset, Magnetic Me, Owlet, AOL, Larson Doors, Cariuma, Oishii, Halfdays, Honors, New York University, Columbia University & many more for over 20 years.

Key Expertise:

- Shopify Ecosystem: 10+ years building in the Shopify ecosystem, including headless implementations, custom app solutions, CMS integrations, ADA compliance–including working with the Shopify core frontend team on ADA enhancements to Universal Checkout–and performance optimization.
- Shopify Plus & Unified Commerce: Leverage Shopify Plus & its Unified Commerce toolkit to deliver seamless omnichannel experiences, streamline operations, & support complex enterprise requirements.
- 3rd Party App stack: Yotpo, Nosto, Gorgias, Recharge, Rebuy, Okendo, Loop, Kustomer, Klaviyo, Algolia, SearchSpring, & others.
- Enterprise Brands: Work extensively with high-profile clients such as Crocs, Suja Organic, (Vive & Slice), Ouai, Owlet, AOL, Milani Cosmetics, Halfdays, Fortune Brands (MOEN), Cariuma, Oishii, The Outset, & Public Rec.
- Leadership & Management: Lead engineering teams, foster a culture of technical excellence company-wide, & deliver higher-quality code with fewer QA cycles.
- Technical Versatility: React, Next.js, Vue, & Node, with a deep understanding of SEO, ADA compliance, & crafting scalable systems.

Engineering & Leadership Philosophy:

I prioritize a culture of technical excellence & ownership, empowering teams to deliver high-quality work efficiently while continuously synthesizing their work with the needs of the business. My approach emphasizes:

- Team Growth: Enable engineers to grow by fostering an environment that rewards proactive problem-solving, innovation & understanding of the business.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with design teams to balance development cost trade-offs, resulting in faster, higher-quality deliverables.
- Business First Solutions: Partner with clients to translate complex technical concepts into actionable business strategies & vice versa, ensuring solutions align with short & long term goals.
